delivery.timing_scope: Tools, snapshot creation, facts, Python executors and Blender jobs are nested under the calling session or preflight.

python.timing_scope: Executor encloses packet validation and worker execution. Worker CPU/RSS are individual-process observations.

observation.selection_scope: Version-aware saved-model preview component in this isolated experiment

decision_rule.required: Both v2 saved repairs pass fixed restoration and technical criteria, and both obtain actual saved-version views
decision_rule.default_selection: Retain V1 if second-stage total Pro wall is higher, or repair/technical quality criteria fail. Component feedback availability and full-stage performance are reported separately.
decision_rule.generalization: Single fixed synthetic case, no general causal performance or image-reconstruction claim

observation.interpretation: All four meet the fixed minimum restoration criteria. V2 adds actual saved-file visual feedback. Native restoration precision declined substantially between stages. The observed timing difference does not establish a matched-quality or general causal speed benefit.
observation.preview_after_final_geometry: Each V2 preview followed its only submit. No edit followed either preview.
observation.model_method_variation: Both routes identify current coordinate-grid residuals. Their independently chosen restoration algorithms differ across stages.

read_path_corrections: The new batch has no PLAN.json. Current schemas were read from the actual session, CASE_BINDING, IMAGE_BINDING and CAMERAS files.
An rg wildcard was passed as a literal Windows path and returned filename syntax error. Direct named-file reads supplied the required schemas.
observation.development_wall_measurement: Parent dispatch and tool timeline retain the implementation interval.
observation.validation_scope: Only AST parsing, Python compilation and hashes of the four frozen quality/facts/scoring modules were executed. Runtime jobs remain for the parent.
observation.cost_rule: The AST interval nests within shell wall time. Runtime helpers count fixed unique job labels and expose reused labels on later invocations.

consumer_changes.instruction_addendum: After an edit, images() now returns four views rendered from your current saved model with the same frozen cameras. Compare these with the normal reference images you already received before finishing. Initial images remain fixed; numerical and saved-file quality records remain available.

observation.issue: Both first-stage final answers lack post-edit visual feedback. Native's second images call redelivered the same eight initial PNGs.
observation.selected_change: Keep initial eight-image delivery. Once the isolated saved model is edited, images() renders four current same-camera model views, version- and saved-SHA-bound with caching. Both routes have the same tool and shared usage guidance.
observation.expected_component_effect: Actual saved-model visual feedback replaces stale initial-image repetition after edits. Rendering has an explicit additional cost. Target geometry remains unavailable.

consumer_changes.instruction_addendum: After an edit, images() now returns four views rendered from your current saved model with the same frozen cameras. Compare these with the normal reference images you already received before finishing. Initial images remain fixed; numerical and saved-file quality records remain available.

observation.invariants: Same sample, initial damaged blend, clean PNGs, cameras, initial public packet, task, domains, displacement budgets, model/effort, tool count/deadline, hidden target and scoring code. No hidden target or mask enters the image tool.
observation.supporting_audit_change: Image audit must validate each response's actual PNG source and distinguish frozen input blocks from saved-version preview blocks. This measures the selected change.

acceptance.required: Both v2 saved repairs pass fixed restoration and technical criteria, and both obtain actual saved-version views
acceptance.default_selection: Retain V1 if second-stage total Pro wall is higher, or repair/technical quality criteria fail. Component feedback availability and full-stage performance are reported separately.
acceptance.generalization: Single fixed synthetic case, no general causal performance or image-reconstruction claim

observation.synthetic_cue: V1 native identifies 1/4096 m coordinate-grid residuals and infers a shared correction direction. The high restoration precision depends on that current-input cue; PNG causal contribution is unmeasured.

observation.read_only_contract_reads_before_registra: The fixed review, task and planner preflight were read while the preceding task remained delivered. Construction, writes and delegation began after write43 registration.

initial_failures: Numerical read lacked the existing SciPy dependency search path, then recovered
An extra lookup used a nonexistent old spec field, then recovered
read_only_auditor.warning: An rg query named nonexistent tools/scripts paths
read_only_auditor.result: Current damaged packet matches fresh readback, current facts descriptor is actually readable, hidden clean read paths and stale references are rejected, and public tools contain target-free technical QA only.
read_only_auditor.scope: Agent-reported shell costs, underlying raw tool events retained in the auditor chat. Parallel tool wall is not a substitute for the missing individual shell wall.

observation.consumer_access_restriction: AST and import restrictions plus CPython file/process/native audit hooks with per-version exact read-only packet allowlists and own-session payload access. Process-internal controls, no OS sandbox certification.
observation.truth_separation: Construct/score processes hold target geometry and support. Consumer input and initial geometry come from the actual damaged blend and independent reader.
observation.normal_source: Recomputed from actual damaged saved vertices, with current topology. No old clean normals or damage-generation parameters in the public packet.

attempts.cost_measurement: exec_command wall time. Python did not produce a preflight attempt record.

attempts.read_failure: Referenced old ENVIRONMENT.json did not exist. Reused the Python path declared in the old common.py.

source_read_path_corrections: Old case directories use private/cases/<case>/ rather than private/case/.
Initial rg of the new batch directory preceded its creation.
observation.nested_cost_rule: The nested preflight and process CPU values overlap. Count shell wall once and retain nested measurements as breakdowns.
observation.implementation_development_wall_measurem: Not independently timed in this subtask. Parent dispatch and task-tool timeline retain the development interval.
unmeasured_costs: Editor/model development token or monetary cost
File-search and implementation process CPU/RSS outside the measured numerical preflight
Full developer wall time outside the parent task timeline

frozen.interpretation: Exact executed sources, including the private fixed scorer. No private target is supplied to consumers.
Exact executed sources, including the private fixed scorer. No private target is supplied to consumers.

accounting: There is no additive grand total across nested timers. Pro session wall includes tools and their Python, facts and Blender work.
Monitor-copy identities are retained. Each unique root launch and each unique Blender job is counted once within its own scope.
Process-tree CPU is the monitor's tree_cpu_s. Process CPU is separately reported. RSS totals always use maxima. Short unsampled descendants remain unmeasured.
Stage consumer totals and other phase root totals cover their named scopes. Root CPU/RSS include children and cannot be added to the Python, bridge or Blender subsets.
Preflight evidence retains all recorded attempts, including failures and rejected-access tests. Latest pass files do not replace earlier raw execution receipts.
Evidence timing paths preserve cumulative and per-attempt observations without summing these representations together.

unmeasured.explanation: Preparation/agent cost metadata is preserved verbatim where recorded. The collector does not infer model charges or unrecorded usage from wall time.
